coordinate_system.pixel_reference: 216 px per PowerPoint inch at the target raster mapping

theme.design_intent: Modern, sparse MBFD instructional design derived from the approved source template. Each physical display functions as an independent safe reading zone.

media_policy.image: copy original binary; contain by default; preserve hyperlink/alt text
media_policy.svg: transfer native when supported; otherwise rasterize at high resolution
media_policy.embedded_video: copy/re-embed binary and poster when supported; otherwise linked poster + sidecar file + review flag
media_policy.online_video: preserve exact URL; attempt native PowerPoint online video; always retain clickable poster fallback
media_policy.audio: re-embed when supported; otherwise explicit file/link fallback + review flag
media_policy.chart: native transfer > recreate from extracted data > high-resolution rendered fallback
media_policy.smartart_or_complex_group: native XML transfer > high-resolution rendered fallback
media_policy.ole: preserve visible rendering and source object when possible; always flag for review if native transfer is uncertain
